At the end of 2019, BCE retail customer connections totaled 18,983,510, and were comprised of the following:

- 9,957,962 wireless subscribers, up 3.6% compared to 2018, comprised of 9,159,940 postpaid subscribers, an increase of 3.7% over last year, and 798,022 prepaid subscribers, up 2.3% year over year
- 3,555,601 retail high-speed Internet subscribers, 4.3% higher than last year

## BCE

BCE operating revenues grew by 2.1% in 2019, compared to last year, driven by growth across all three of our segments. Total operating revenues consisted of service revenues of $20,737 million and product revenues of $3,227 million in 2019, up 1.4% and 6.6%, respectively, year over year.
